questions.title: Music club - Part 1

metadata.scenario: Please tell us about the last time you listened to music.

questions.stem: You are a member of a music club. You are talking to three other members in the music club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.

questions.prompt: Hi! How often do you listen to music?
questions.sample_answer:
I listen to music at home every evening. I really like listening to music because it helps me feel comfortable after a day at work.


I’m a big fan of music, especially K-pop and R&B. I listen to music whenever I have free time, and I also enjoy listening while studying or doing housework.
Please tell us about the last time you listened to music.


The last time I listened to music was 5 hours ago. I enjoyed my favorite songs along with the attractive videos on YouTube.

questions.prompt: I plan to give my son music lessons, but he doesn’t like it. What should I do?
questions.sample_answer:
I suggest showing your son some of the benefits of music. It can help reduce anxiety, improve mood, and enhance work efficiency. Understanding these benefits may make him more interested in music lessons.


Or
Everyone has their own preferences, so if your son doesn’t enjoy the lessons, try to find out what interests him. You could nurture his other hobbies and introduce him to music in a way that suits his interests.

questions.prompt: Do you agree that music is essential in a culture
questions.sample_answer: I agree that music is essential in a culture. It reflects a society's values, history, and traditions. Music helps people connect, express emotions, and preserve cultural identity across generations.
